title: Away-Store Share of the Fleet Diagnostic Credit — Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
On a Service Accounts and Repair Orders commercial fleet account (Commercial Fleet Account - Net 15 or Net 30), the away-store share follows where the diagnosis was done and the maintenance record of the vehicle on the diagnostic fee in the Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans records:

| Diagnostic fee charged at | Vehicle on the diagnostic fee carries an active Kessler Care maintenance plan | The credit is multiplied by |
|---|---|---|
| A store other than the account's home store | Yes | 0.9 |
| A store other than the account's home store | No | 0.75 |
| The account's home store | Either | not reduced |

The account's home store is the store where the account was opened; the diagnostic fee is the latest one charged on the account.
